notes.note: Orphan entry: 0710 only shows #0.1 (OkWin) and #0.4 (Yes/No prompt), so no speaker. Source has a stray typo letter inside the Gundam Head name; ignored. Plural 'Gundam Heads' because the line is about them multiplying.
Yes/No battle prompt, phrased like the established 'Read the sign?' prompts.

Leader block #0.1-15 uses TextIdOffset+0+k with k from the first Pt_Chara_Check chain (order: W, OOO, Black RX, Den-O Sword, Rider 1, Mebius, Zero, Seven, Taro, Ultraman, Wing Zero, 00, Zeta, God, Nu). Voiced from wording; 'that Gaia Memory' = the 'memory' Seravee's Voice located in 0709.
Source puts Memory Memory in quote brackets; kept as quotes. Term spelling as established in quest/talk passes.

Script check: blocks #0.18-32, #0.38-52 and #0.54-68 are called with a constant text index (+17/+37/+53, no +k), with the speaker label set to the current leader. So only #0.18, #0.38 and #0.54 ever display, for every leader; the other 42 rows are dead variants, translated anyway and voiced from wording. Extracted label 'Nu Gundam' is just the last constant the extractor saw; the real speaker is the party leader.
Rough variant (contemptuous verb ending); 'damn' carries it. Likely Den-O Sword or another rough leader.
Ankh. Subject restored as 'we' (smash and move on is the group's path).
Gundam Head roar; no established English yet (story_148 untranslated). Chose 'Gyurururururu...!!!'; story_148's longer variant should match this spelling.
Labelled Ankh and verified: script sets Ankh's name before +36; he is the one thrown back after grabbing the tentacles.
Polite variant with an honorific on Ankh (Mebius-style); honorific dropped per style, politeness carried by 'all right'.
Rough variant ('still hanging around' with contempt); rendered with 'damn things'.
Ankh orders the retreat; subject restored as 'We're falling back'.

Block #0.73-87 uses +72+k with the second Pt_Chara_Check chain (God, OOO, Nu, W, Zeta, Black RX, Wing Zero, Rider 1, 00, Den-O Sword, Taro, Ultraman, Seven, Mebius, Zero). Confirmed by #0.81 (00 names itself) and #0.82 in story_150 (Momotaros catchphrase). #0.73 = God Gundam, addressing the Gundam Head directly.
Wing Zero (Heero): 'targets' kept from the source's mission wording.
Rider 1; the final kiai is the Rider jump cry, rendered 'Toh!!'.

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers verified against 0710/0711 bytecode: 0710#0.3 is never shown (orphan); in 0711 the blocks at #0.18, #0.38 and #0.54 use a constant index, so only their first variant ever displays (game-side quirk, harmless). Leader orders taken from the two Pt_Chara_Check chains. New: Gundam Head roar 'Gyurururururu...!!!' (no prior English). No new names.
